officialSources.manualAcquisitionProcedure: 1. Navigate to https://www.legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/ in browser. 2. Select 'The Constitution of India (English)'. 3. Save PDF to data/constitution/constitution_of_india.pdf. 4. Verify SHA-256.
